note: What the autopilot engine (operating/autopilot.py) watches and prepares. A source maps an object type to the event its new or changed records emit; an autopilot is event type + conditions -> a general handler that prepares work -> business rule -> due. No entry names a record, a party or a person.

autopilots.label: Invoice not sent to the customer
autopilots.off_reason: measured 2026-10-06..25: a person mailed 13 of 199 new invoices within 3 days; the rule fired 154 times, 11 right (7%); no customer habit share raised it past 12%

autopilots.label: R&D or sample project waiting on us: status update

Gen 11 mail carries no customer links, so every party was an outside domain (supplier threads included). Re-measure once mail carries customer links

autopilots.label: Reply waiting in Teams
autopilots.note: to_me: a question put to the person directly (a one-to-one chat, or an @mention) needs their reply whoever asks. The sender record (answers_sender [3, 0.9]) had left 6 of 31 real answered items with no draft (senders answered 3 of 5 to 80 of 99 times, or new); in one-to-one chats 2026-10-19..11-18 the person wrote back within 24 h after 95 of 120 messages with a question mark (Vince) and 11 of 11 (the owner). A group message not naming them is not this rule's (teams_group_turn). asks: the chat message asks its reader something (owner walk 2026-11-17: 0 of 473 items used). Certain no in code (no words; a note to all not @mentioning the reader; closing); every other message read live by a small model, batched and cached, failures kept (chat_ask_model). Fresh Teams 2026-11-10..16 (never used before), haiku: 27 of 30 kept were asks (26 alone, one more with its burst), 0 of 30 removed were; the 10 review phrases (no "?") all kept.

autopilots.label: Your turn in a group chat
autopilots.note: the first message after the person's own one in a group chat they keep writing in (measured on tuned days 2026-10-06..11-03: they wrote back within 72 h after 94% of them); or a question no one @mentioned from a sender whose messages there the person is usually the first to answer (usual_answerer, last 14 days; measured on group chats 2026-10-12..11-10, messages with a question mark and no @mention: the usual first answerer (half or more) wrote within 24 h after 26 of 31, any other member after 52 of 125)

autopilots.label: Work a message left you
autopilots.note: The work a message from a person leaves its reader beyond a reply, in the triage model's own words (operating/autopilot_message_work.py). Fresh days 11-19..20: about a quarter of the send time no item anticipated acted on something a message told the person. Only a message the model read as fyi with work named, to the reader (not only copied), from someone they know, and only when no other autopilot prepared the message for them (fallback). A standing job: the job session's proposals when it is on, else the to-do.

autopilots.label: System work from a message
autopilots.note: Owner 11-18 ('doing FULL JOBS'): one general mechanism (operating/autopilot_jobs.py). The model reads the event and the records with the Ask's tools as the person and proposes each system change with the Ask's write tool contract; the person reviews each through the prepared-writes desk. These job_* entries only pick the event types and whose item it is; a small model first decides whether the event asks for a system change at all.

autopilots.label: Prepared for you
autopilots.note: The decision step as one general assistant (operating/autopilot_agent.py), used only with PLX_AUTOPILOT_AGENT=1: it then decides every message event in place of the rule-matched message autopilots; the person's opt-in, the screens, the learned rules and the confirm before anything is sent or written stay.

autopilots.label: Prepared for your hour
autopilots.note: The assistant's time-driven look (operating/autopilot_agent_io.py look_events): with PLX_AUTOPILOT_AGENT=1, one look per opted-in person at the day's start and each working hour (US Eastern, Monday to Friday) for work due, waiting or changed with no message to answer; proposals, questions as to-dos, nothing sent or written before the person confirms.

autopilots.label: Recurring work due
autopilots.note: A person's own recurring work no other autopilot prepares (operating/recurring_work.py: read from what they did on a schedule over the last 60 days), proposed through the jobs mechanism when it is due.
